What Exactly is a Receipt Scanner App?

A receipt scanner app is a mobile application designed to scan paper receipts using your phone’s camera. Once scanned, it instantly captures details like transaction amounts, vendors, dates, and categorizes them for easy tracking. This method saves time significantly.
